abstract: A case of a 19-year-old female with 46 XY gonadal dysgenesis and five different histological subtypes of germ cell malignancies is described. Both adnexa were removed, preserving the uterus. Pathology revealed gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma differentiation present in both gonads and in the left gonad mature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and endodermal sinus tumor were identified as well. She received no adjuvant treatment and has remained well 30 months after diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 46,XY性腺形成不全を伴う19歳のXY女性で、5種類の組織型の胚細胞腫瘍を認めた症例を報告する。両側付属器を切除し、子宮は温存した。病理学的に、両側性腺に性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）分化を認め、左側性腺には成熟奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍も認めた。補助療法は行わず、診断後30か月経過しても良好な状態を保っている。
